title: Budget and Revenue Analysis
text:
This page analyzes the budgets and revenues of the 104 well-known films. Figure 1 below summarizes and visualizes this relationship.

plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Budget (millions of U.S. dollars)")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (millions of U.S. dollars)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Scatter plot of budget (x-axis) against revenue (y-axis)

title: Box Office Analysis
text:
The dataset analyzed on this website contains 104 well-known films from 1980 to 2025. It includes the approximate budgets, worldwide revenues, runtimes, and ratings for each film. You can find the following analyses on this website:

Budget and Revenue
Runtime and Ratings
The Bond Films

I did not use any AI tools during this quiz. I did reference Lectures 10-11 notes.

title: Runtime and Rating Analysis
text:
This page analyzes the runtimes and ratings of the 104 well-known films.
Figure 1 below summarizes and visualizes this relationship, where runtime is given in minutes and rating is the public rating from IMDB between 0 and 10.

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("Rating (0-10)")
plt.show()







Figure 1: Scatter plot of runtime (x-axis) against rating (y-axis)

title: James Bond Films Analysis
text:
This page analyzes only James Bond films. The first Bond films in this dataset aired in 1995 and the last Bond film aired in 2021.

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))
